claims.quote: A simple selfhosted URL shortener
claims.statement: The product is a self-hosted URL shortener — the core function of the category exists

claims.quote: with no unnecessary features
claims.statement: The product carries no features beyond the ones necessary to its function — a boundary on its feature set

claims.quote: The scratch docker image is <4.5 MB (compressed),
claims.statement: The docker image built from scratch is smaller than 4.5 MB compressed

claims.quote: the alpine one is <8.5 MB (compressed),
claims.statement: The docker image built from alpine is smaller than 8.5 MB compressed

claims.quote: it uses <10 MB of RAM under regular use.
claims.statement: The service runs in under 10 MB of RAM in ordinary operation

claims.quote: I consider this project to be complete, not dead.
claims.statement: The maintainer regards the project as finished and maintained rather than abandoned

claims.quote: I'm unlikely to add any new features,
claims.statement: The maintainer does not plan to add new features to the product

claims.quote: I will try and fix every bug you report.
claims.statement: The maintainer intends to fix bugs reported to the project

claims.quote:
I will also try to keep it updated in terms of
security vulnerabilities.
claims.statement: The maintainer intends to keep the product updated against security vulnerabilities

claims.quote:
I decided
to rewrite it in Rust
claims.statement: The product is a Rust rewrite of the simply-shorten project — a provenance and implementation-language claim

claims.quote: add some features to it that I thought were essential (e.g. hit counting).
claims.statement: The product includes the features the maintainer added over simply-shorten, hit counting among them

claims.quote: Chhoto (ছোট, [pronunciation](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/ছোট)) is the Bangla word for small. URL means, well... URL. So the name simply means Small URL.
claims.statement: The product's name means Small URL: 'Chhoto' is the Bangla word for small.

claims.quote: The database is cleared every 15 minutes
claims.statement: The seller's hosted demo instance clears its database every 15 minutes.

claims.quote: Shortens URLs of any length
claims.statement: The tool contains a shortening function that accepts a submitted URL and returns a short link, with no restriction on the URL's length.

claims.quote: to a randomly generated link
claims.statement: The short links produced by the tool are randomly generated.

claims.quote: Automatic expiry of links after a chosen time.
claims.statement: The tool contains expiry logic that deactivates or removes links after a user-chosen time.

claims.quote: Allows you to specify the shortened URL instead of the generated one
claims.statement: Optionally, the user can choose a custom short URL instead of the randomly generated one.

claims.quote: Opening the shortened URL in your browser will instantly redirect you to the correct long URL.
claims.statement: The server contains a redirect handler that maps each short URL to its stored long URL and issues a redirect response.

claims.quote: The docker image is only ~6MB
claims.statement: The Docker image is approximately 6MB.

claims.quote: RAM uasge stays under 5MB under normal use.
claims.statement: RAM usage stays under 5MB under normal use.

claims.quote: Counts number of hits for each short link
claims.statement: The tool contains hit-counting code that keeps a per-link visit count.

claims.quote: only the hit is recorded, and nothing else
claims.statement: Only the hit count is recorded about each visit, and nothing else — no other data about the visitor or the visit is stored.

claims.quote: Short links can be edited after creation.
claims.statement: Existing short links can be edited after they are created.

claims.quote: Each short link may have custom notes attached to it.
claims.statement: Custom notes can be attached to each short link.

claims.quote: The UI features filtering for links, based on short link, long link, and notes.
claims.statement: The UI supports filtering links by short link, long link, and notes.

claims.quote: QR codes can be generated for easy sharing.
claims.statement: The tool can generate QR codes for short links.

claims.quote: Supports operation using API key
claims.statement: The tool supports operation using an API key.

claims.quote: lets the user provide hashed password and API key
claims.statement: The user can supply the password and API key in hashed form.

claims.quote: Has a robust JSON-RPC adjacent API.
claims.statement: The tool exposes an API resembling JSON-RPC.

claims.quote: Has a mobile friendly UI
claims.statement: The frontend contains responsive, mobile-oriented layout and styling.

claims.quote: automatic dark mode
claims.statement: The UI has automatic dark mode.

claims.quote: Can serve a custom landing page, if needed.
claims.statement: The tool can serve a custom landing page.

claims.quote: Has a public mode, where anyone can add links without authentication.
claims.statement: A public mode exists in which anyone can add links without authenticating.

claims.quote: Deleting or listing available links will need admin access using the password.
claims.statement: Deleting links and listing available links require admin access using the password.

claims.quote: It's also possible to completely disable the frontend.
claims.statement: The frontend can be completely disabled.

claims.quote: It's also possible to force an expiry time for public instances
claims.statement: An expiry time can be forced for links on public instances.

claims.quote: Allows setting the URL of your website
claims.statement: The URL of the user's website is configurable.

claims.quote: Links are stored in an SQLite database
claims.statement: Links are stored in an SQLite database.

claims.quote: which is configured to be ACID by default
claims.statement: The SQLite database is configured to be ACID by default.

claims.quote: Options are available for tuning the database to the user's liking.
claims.statement: Options are available for tuning the database.

claims.quote: Available as a Docker container
claims.statement: The tool is available as a Docker container.

claims.quote: with a provided compose file
claims.statement: A Docker Compose file is provided.

claims.quote: Backend written in Rust using [Actix Web](https://actix.rs/)
claims.statement: The backend is written in Rust using the Actix Web framework.

claims.quote: frontend written in plain HTML and vanilla JS, using [Pure CSS](https://purecss.io/) for styling
claims.statement: The frontend is written in plain HTML and vanilla JS, styled with Pure CSS.

claims.quote: Uses very basic authentication using a provided password.
claims.statement: Authentication uses a provided password.

claims.quote: It's not encrypted in transport.
claims.statement: The authentication is not encrypted in transport.

claims.quote: **Tracking or spying of any kind.**
claims.statement: Under the heading 'Bloat that will not be implemented', the target performs no tracking or spying of any kind.

claims.quote: The only logs that still exist are some very simple ones, mostly meant for debugging.
claims.statement: The only logging the target performs is a small set of simple logs intended mostly for debugging; no other logging exists.

claims.quote: **User management.** If you need a shortener for your whole organization, either run separate containers for everyone or use something else.
claims.statement: The target has no user management feature; a buyer needing a shortener for a whole organization must run separate containers or use other software.

claims.quote: **Cookies, newsletters**, "we value your privacy" popups or any of the multiple other ways modern web shows how anti-user it is. We all hate those, and they're not needed here.
claims.statement: The target does not use cookies, newsletters, or privacy-consent popups.

claims.quote: **Paywalls** or messages begging for donations.
claims.statement: The target contains no paywalls or donation-request messages.

claims.quote: The list of adjectives and names used for random short url generation is a modified version of [this list used by docker](https://github.com/moby/moby/blob/master/internal/namesgenerator/names-generator.go).
claims.statement: The word list used to generate random short URLs is a modified version of Docker's names-generator list.

claims.quote: It is highly recommended that you [enable WAL mode](./docs/INSTALLATION.md#chhoto_sqlite_use_wal_mode).
claims.statement: The target's database can be run in WAL mode via a configuration option, and the seller recommends enabling it.

claims.quote: Although it's unlikely, it's possible that your database is mangled after some update.
claims.statement: Updating the target carries a risk that the database is mangled; the seller states this is unlikely but possible.

claims.quote: If you intend to have more than a few thousand short links, it's strongly recommended that you use the UID [`CHHOTO_SLUG_STYLE`](./docs/INSTALLATION.md#chhoto_slug_style) with a [`CHHOTO_SLUG_LENGTH`](./docs/INSTALLATION.md#chhoto_slug_length) of 16 or more. Otherwise, generating new links will start to fail after a while.
claims.statement: The target's link-creation path generates new short URLs by drawing random slugs from a finite set of words, with no setting in effect that ensures long unique slugs unless CHHOTO_SLUG_STYLE with a CHHOTO_SLUG_LENGTH of 16 or more is configured.

claims.quote: For safety, only `https`,`http`,`ftp`, and `magnet` links are allowed for long links by default.
claims.statement: By default, the target accepts long links using only the https, http, ftp and magnet protocols; other protocols require the CHHOTO_EXTRA_PROTOCOLS option.

claims.quote: Shortens URLs of any length
claims.statement: URLs submitted to the tool are shortened to working short links regardless of how long they are.

claims.quote: Automatic expiry of links after a chosen time.
claims.statement: Links stop working automatically once the chosen time has passed, without any manual action.

claims.quote: Opening the shortened URL in your browser will instantly redirect you to the correct long URL.
claims.statement: Opening a short URL in a browser sends the visitor directly to the correct long URL, with no intermediate redirection page.

claims.quote: Counts number of hits for each short link
claims.statement: Each visit to a short link is counted, so the recorded hit count reflects the link's actual traffic.

claims.quote: Has a mobile friendly UI
claims.statement: The UI renders and remains usable when accessed from a mobile device.

claims.quote: If you intend to have more than a few thousand short links, it's strongly recommended that you use the UID [`CHHOTO_SLUG_STYLE`](./docs/INSTALLATION.md#chhoto_slug_style) with a [`CHHOTO_SLUG_LENGTH`](./docs/INSTALLATION.md#chhoto_slug_length) of 16 or more. Otherwise, generating new links will start to fail after a while.
claims.statement: When the target holds more than a few thousand short links under the default slug settings, attempts to generate new short links begin to fail.
